shortDescription: Qantas Airways Ltd. and Virgin Australia Holdings Ltd. are charging between two and four times typical fares for flights to Melbourne for Saturday’s AFL Grand Final, according to Bloomberg.The pricing has drawn anger from fans and highlights the airlines’ dominance on the route.
